agent_instructions.how_to_pick: Start with CRITICAL items that have no dependencies. Claim via POST /api/v2/tasks/claim.

agent_instructions.autonomous_loop: Agent picks task → reads brief → clones repo → builds MVP → tests → deploys → marks done → picks next task. Human reviews at 'review' column.
